Shared-grade relative error is 1.0000 (plateau ~ 100%), and unconstrained relative error is 0.9995. Localized wavelet bumps cannot approximate macroscopic smooth targets.

negativity_transfer_threshold.mathematical_meaning: To guarantee B(f_n, f_n) < 0, the H^1 approximation error ||f_n - f_*|| must be strictly below 1.655920e-04. Combined with the Poincaré lower bound ||f_n - f_*||_{H^1} >= 6.3855 in the shrinking component regime, this transfers the structural support obstruction directly to a rigorous barrier against negativity transfer.

answers_to_required_questions.q1_universal_divergence_withdrawn: YES. The claim that every legal sequence with h -> 0 has diverging norm is withdrawn. It is defeated by coefficient rescaling f_h = h * g_h / ||g_h||_{H^1}, which has ||f_h||_{H^1} = h. The exact theorem replacing it is the Poincare support-component lower bound.
answers_to_required_questions.q2_excluded_support_component_regimes: Any sequence of configurations (C_n, h_n) whose maximal connected component length ell(C_n, h_n) -> 0 is rigorously excluded from approximating any non-zero target f_* in H^1. By the Poincare support theorem, ||f - f_*||_{H^1} >= max(0, (||f_*||_{L^2} - ell ||f_*'||_{L^2}) / (1 + ell)), which approaches ||f_*||_{L^2} > 0 as ell -> 0, completely independent of coefficient sizes.
answers_to_required_questions.q3_actual_sequences_tested: Tested: (1) Disjoint canonical configuration at h=0.02; (2) Multi-station overlapping configurations at h=0.1; (3) Smooth admissible target f_* = (D_u^2 - 1/4) (1 - u^2)^4 satisfying both pole vanishing integrals identically; (4) Constrained shared-grade optimization vs unconstrained independent stations.
answers_to_required_questions.q4_error_coefficients_geometry_positivit: In the shrinking component regime (ell -> 0), the Poincare bound prevents H^1 approximation. In the overlapping macroscopic regime, keeping components connected as h -> 0 requires diverging grade counts M_n -> infty, which breaches the prime resonance threshold (2h > Delta_res), activating prime terms W_prime and severe ill-conditioning. In the nonshrinking bandwidth regime (h >= h_min), the Fourier transform hat{f}(xi) is forced to vanish at the universal zeros of hat{kappa}(h*xi), creating an irreducible spectral error against general smooth targets.
answers_to_required_questions.q5_continuity_proof_status: Continuity |B_log(f, l)| <= C_R ||f||_{H^1} ||l||_{H^1} is derived on V_R using the Mellin transform representation, the unconditional Trudgian zero density N(t) <= (t/2pi)log(t), and Cauchy-Schwarz. C_R depends continuously on the support radius R. Negativity transfer is formalized as an endpoint inequality.
answers_to_required_questions.q6_complete_matrix_certification: Rigorous certificate: lambda_min(M_T) >= 3.327414e10 at T=16000 (z=320). Outward quadrature error bound ||M_T - Mhat_T||_op <= e_T = 1.0e5. Archimedean tail R_T is proved PSD via NIST DLMF 5.7.6 digamma monotonicity. Prime evaluations vanish identically (W_prime = 0) due to same-grade and cross-grade resonance gaps > 2h = 0.04. Net certified positive margin: lambda_min(W) >= L_T - e_T = 3.327404e10 > 0.
answers_to_required_questions.q7_conditional_detection_status: The localized small-bandwidth bump approximation scheme within F_pos is closed by the Poincare support obstruction. However, the conditional proposition D_F: H ==> E_F remains strictly OPEN and is equivalent to not H (RH) under P_F. Failure of one approximation scheme does not refute D_F.
answers_to_required_questions.q8_arithmetic_separation_role: Arithmetic separation (Lindemann transcendence excluding tau^K/tau^J in Q) is used to prove that active stations across distinct grades have non-zero resonance gaps Delta_res > 0, ensuring prime vanishing W_prime = 0 for 2h < Delta_res. It does not automatically construct an integer collision m*tau^K = n*tau^J from spectral positivity alone.
